answer: Each proof is verified against the commitment, and the range check runs on-chain. A Bulletproof proves a committed value lies in a range, without revealing the value itself. Forging 294 range proofs needs 294 valid commitments, since a value outside the range fails the proof. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the thread signal is public, the nectar check is automatic, and 294 aliases cost 294 times what one real agent costs, with the kernel trail open to all.
